before.requirement: Initialize notes before the assembly pass creates sections and allocates notes-backed section information.
before.reason: The harness calls read_begin before perform_an_assembly_pass, and the before version initializes notes in read_begin.

after.requirement: Initialize notes before the assembly pass creates sections and allocates notes-backed section information.
after.reason: The after version initializes notes in main, while read_begin no longer does so. The harness bypasses main and proceeds to the assembly pass.

claims.reason: Moving notes initialization from read_begin to main changes the same harness from satisfying the prerequisite to missing it.
